title: Crops and machines
description: Machines to help automate things while you learn to make new foods!
body:

# WHAT IS THIS PACK ABOUT?
dont like doing manual labor?
rather have some complicated redstone machine do a sugar cane farm for?
that mod grinder too slow?


## Welcome to the world of automation!
learn how to make a mobfarm with fans to push mobs down the chute faster! or maybe learn how to make a sugar cane farm that harvests automatically and turn that sugar cane into cake automatically!

speaking of farms learn how to make new foods like tacos, onigiri, or sheppards pie! too many apples? turn them into a crate!

### The world is yours!
Storage is no longer an issue as you can make a storage tower to get rid of that pesky chest room or random clutter pile of random junk!
yeah you know that random shulker pile that has stuff you say you will sort later well sort it no longer as there is now a storage tower!
